notes: Choose Scalping (M5), Day trading (M15/H1), or Both. Day and hybrid execution are demo-only.
Adds indicative entry, SL and TP zone previews with account, policy, quote-age and expiry checks; previews never authorize orders.
Day trading uses UTC-reset tick-volume VWAP, H1 EMA20/50 and M15 RSI50 recovery, structural stops, 2R targets and a 0.20% equity risk budget including estimated costs.
Day positions capture a 20:55 UTC exit; broker SL/TP remain active. Offline connections, broker limits and minimum lots can prevent intended entries or exits.
Includes UTC session switches, editable account-wide maximum open trades, demo Sentinel and a compact Home dashboard.
Improves phone-clock correction, connection status, open-position freshness and last-reported spread display. Order dispatch still requires fresh quotes.
Requires connector 0.8.13 for day/hybrid and zone-preview support. Configure Gemini privately; every entry retains AI, news, risk, account and broker checks.
Gemini score >=85 is an assessment, not a win probability. Live scalping needs separate explicit account approval; day/hybrid remain demo-only.
Updating the app does not select a new style or activate trading. Existing positions retain their captured management rules.
